The complete GWAS-VCF metadata declares ieu-b-38 as a continuous study with 7,088,083 HG19/GRCh37 harmonized variants and no unread or unharmonized variants. The GWAS-VCF specification defines ES relative to ALT, SE, LP as -log10(P), AF as alternate-allele frequency, SS as sample size, and the sample ID field as the study variant ID. The source-specific materializer requires FORMAT/ID to agree with the VCF rsID, requires INFO/AF to equal FORMAT/AF, and floors only P below 1e-300 to prevent silent downstream floating-point underflow. The source carries no imputation-INFO field; INFO/AF is frequency, not imputation quality.

Its markername is only chromosome:position:first_allele:second_allele, not an rsID; an audited GRCh37 coordinate-and-allele-to-rsID mapping is required before harmonization. The three meta-analysis platforms are collapsed variant by variant by maximum effective cases, exactly as documented upstream.
